<div id="sge">

  <p class="lede">Predicts how long a Seaglider will last on a given mission. Kongsberg publishes
  no endurance tool for firmware 66.12, so this one is <b>fitted to our own gliders' logs</b>:
  every dive's per-device on-times and currents from SG644 (2018, 2019, 2022) and SG150 (2021),
  <span id="n_dives">1,500+</span> dives in all. Run against those dives, it reproduces each
  mission's logged energy to within a few percent (see <a href="#validation">How well it fits</a>).</p>

  <div class="results" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="headline">
      <div class="big"><span class="v" id="o_days">–</span><span class="k">Endurance (days)</span></div>
      <div class="big"><span class="v" id="o_km">–</span><span class="k">Distance through water (km)</span></div>
      <div class="big"><span class="v" id="o_dives">–</span><span class="k">Dives</span></div>
      <div class="load">
        <div>Energy <b id="o_ahday">–</b> Ah/day</div>
        <div>Per dive <b id="o_ahdive">–</b> Ah</div>
        <div>Dive cycle <b id="o_cycle">–</b></div>
        <div>Limited by <b id="o_limit">–</b></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="compare" id="compare"></div>
    <div class="alerts" id="alerts"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="preset">
    <label for="preset">Start from</label>
    <select id="preset"></select>
    <button id="reset" type="button">Reset to this mission</button>
    <span class="note" id="preset_note"></span>
  </div>

  <div class="panels">
    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Dive</h3>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_depth">Dive depth</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_depth" min="10" max="1000" step="10"><span class="unit">m</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_w">Mean vertical speed</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_w" min="0.02" max="0.3" step="0.005"><span class="unit">m/s</span></div>
        <span class="hint" id="h_w">Including apogee. T_DIVE equivalent –</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_surface">Time at surface</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_surface" min="0" step="1"><span class="unit">min</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_maxbuoy">$MAX_BUOY</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_maxbuoy" min="0" step="10"><span class="unit">cc</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_smcc">$SM_CC</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_smcc" min="0" step="10"><span class="unit">cc</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_kb">Data sent per call</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_kb" min="0" step="10"><span class="unit">kB</span></div>
        <span class="hint">Dive data plus capture file. SciCon years sent ~250 kB, 2022 ~90 kB.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_calln">$CALL_NDIVES</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_calln" min="1" max="10" step="1"></div></div>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Glider and battery</h3>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_glider">Calibrated on</label><div class="ctl"><select id="i_glider"><option value="644">SG644 (ours)</option><option value="150">SG150</option></select></div>
        <span class="hint">Which glider's fitted loads to use. Another 66.12 Seaglider: pick the closer pack layout.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_dual">Pack layout</label><div class="ctl"><select id="i_dual"><option value="0">Single pack</option><option value="1">24 V + 10 V packs</option></select></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_cap24" id="l_cap24">Capacity</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_cap24" min="1" step="5"><span class="unit">Ah</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_cap10">10 V pack capacity</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_cap10" min="0" step="5"><span class="unit">Ah</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_v24" id="l_v24">Pack voltage</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_v24" min="5" step="0.1"><span class="unit">V</span></div>
        <span class="hint">Converts the pump's energy into Ah. SG644's lithium pack sat at 12.4–13.9 V.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_reserve">Keep in reserve</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_reserve" min="0" max="90" step="1"><span class="unit">%</span></div></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_pumpf">Pump condition factor</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_pumpf" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.05"></div>
        <span class="hint">1 = the fitted pump law. SG644's pump cost 1.22&times; that in 2022.</span></div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_glide">Glide ratio</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_glide" min="0.5" max="6" step="0.1"><span class="unit">: 1</span></div>
        <span class="hint">Horizontal to vertical, from the flight model. Only affects distance.</span></div>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Science sensors</h3>
      <div class="host" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Sensor host">
        <label><input type="radio" name="host" value="scicon" id="host_scicon"> On the SciCon</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="host" value="tt8" id="host_tt8"> On the TT8 (no SciCon)</label>
      </div>
      <div class="f"><label for="i_interval">Sample interval</label><div class="ctl"><input type="number" id="i_interval" min="1" step="1"><span class="unit">s</span></div></div>
      <div id="sci_rows"></div>
      <p class="sub" id="sci_note" style="font-size:12px;margin:8px 0 0"></p>
    </section>

    <section class="panel">
      <h3>Loggers and other payload</h3>
      <div id="log_rows"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <h2 class="sec">Where the energy goes</h2>
  <div class="charts">
    <figure id="fig_depth">
      <figcaption>Endurance against dive depth</figcaption>
      <div class="legend" id="leg_depth"></div>
      <div id="ch_depth"></div>
      <div class="tip" id="tip_depth"></div>
    </figure>
    <figure id="fig_parts">
      <figcaption>Energy by load, Ah per day</figcaption>
      <div id="ch_parts"></div>
      <div class="tip" id="tip_parts"></div>
    </figure>
  </div>

  <h2 class="sec" id="validation">How well it fits</h2>
  <p class="sub">Each logged dive run through the model using only what a pilot plans with: the
  dive's depth and duration, surface time, $MAX_BUOY, $SM_CC, the data it sent and its sensor
  settings. The model's total against what the glider logged, mission by mission.</p>
  <figure>
    <figcaption>Energy per mission: logged against model</figcaption>
    <div class="legend"><span><i class="dot" style="background:var(--s1)"></i>Logged by the glider</span><span><i class="dot" style="background:var(--s2)"></i>Model</span></div>
    <div id="ch_valid"></div>
    <div class="tip" id="tip_valid"></div>
  </figure>
  <div class="tablewrap" style="margin-top:12px">
    <table id="t_valid"></table>
  </div>

  <h2 class="sec">What the logs showed</h2>
  <div class="notes">
    <div class="note">
      <h4>The glider's battery counter leaves the PAM out</h4>
      <p>SG644's $24V_AH counter books every device except the PAM recorder. The CF card's
      <code>BATTERY</code> tally for mission 5 (to 3 July 2018) lists 45 Ah drawn by the PAM,
      and the counter's 247.6 Ah equals the tally <em>without</em> it. The recorder's
      <code>PAM.CNF</code> puts it on the 15 V main line, so the pack gave
      <b>~293 Ah of 310</b> while the glider reported 248.</p>
      <p>This calculator counts the PAM. When a PAM is fitted, add its time to the glider's
      counter before trusting the remaining capacity.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="note">
      <h4>SciCon or TT8: which is cheaper</h4>
      <p>With the CT, optode and SeaOWL on the SciCon sampling every ~10 s, the SciCon
      averaged <b>25 mA</b> for all of it. Polled by the TT8 instead, the glider charges each
      sensor its <code>.cnf</code> current for every second it is powered, and keeps the TT8
      awake ~3 s per sensor-second. The Contros optode's <code>.cnf</code> says 300 mA for
      2.8 s a sample: 845 mAs, ~3.6&times; what the SciCon drew for all its sensors over a 10 s cycle. On mission 6's dives, without the PAM, that is <b>~88 days on the SciCon against ~44 on the TT8</b>.</p>
      <p>The SciCon reports its own consumption; the TT8 figure is the glider's bookkeeping.
      Part of the gap may be a conservative .cnf rating, so a bench measurement of the optode
      would settle it. Until then, edit a sensor's mA to try a measured value.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="note">
      <h4>What moves endurance most</h4>
      <p><b>The echosounder.</b> In 2022 it logged 400 mA for the whole dive: 0.77 Ah per dive,
      more than everything else together, which is why that mission ran at 16.5 Ah/day against
      2.6–4.5 in the SciCon years.</p>
      <p><b>The pump, then depth.</b> A cc pumped at apogee costs 13 J plus 0.021 J per metre
      of depth, so ~15 J at 100 m and ~34 J at 1000 m. Volume is (MAX_BUOY&nbsp;+&nbsp;SM_CC)
      per dive. SG644 pumped 1.22&times; that in 2022, at a lower pack voltage (12.4 V against
      13.4 V in 2018).</p>
    </div>
    <div class="note">
      <h4>The earlier spreadsheet</h4>
      <p><code>endurance calc.xlsx</code> fitted per-device factors to 92 dives of one
      deployment, and its pump term already scaled with MAX_BUOY&nbsp;+&nbsp;SM_CC. For its own
      settings (990 m, T_DIVE 420, CT and optode on the SciCon) it and this model agree on the
      energy of a dive: <b>0.51 Ah</b> there, <b>0.50 Ah</b> here.</p>
      <p>The endurance differs because it fixed every dive at 2 h. At T_DIVE 420 a 990 m dive
      takes about 7 h, so 303 Ah lasts ~180 days, not 49. It also scaled Iridium and the motors
      by 0.5 and the pump by 0.3 by hand, and added the CTD and O2 on top of the SciCon, which
      already includes them. Those roughly cancelled out.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h2 class="sec">Missions in the archive</h2>
  <div class="tablewrap">
    <table id="t_missions"></table>
  </div>

  <footer class="src">
    <p><b>How it is built.</b> <code>code/extract_seaglider_dives.py</code> reduces the
    deployment archive (the basestation's per-dive netCDF files, 1.6 GB, kept outside the
    repository) to one row per dive in <code>content/data/seaglider-dives.csv</code>.
    <code>code/fit_seaglider_model.py</code> fits each group of loads against what drives it:
    the pump against volume and depth, the motors against dive time, the processor against
    cycle time, Iridium against data sent, and the SciCon against its sample rate. The fit is
    written to <code>content/data/seaglider-model.json</code>.
    <code>node code/build_seaglider_page.js</code> runs <code>code/seaglider_model.js</code>
    on every dive, fails if any mission misses by more than 25%, and only then updates this
    page. Fitted on 2018 alone, the model predicted the 2022 mission, with different sensors
    and no SciCon, to within 7%.</p>
    <p><b>Limits.</b> Everything is calibrated on two gliders on firmware 66.12. Depths beyond
    1000 m, and anything past 300 m for SG150, are extrapolation. The SeaOWL's cost on the
    TT8 is estimated, since it only ever flew on the SciCon. The Kongsberg (iRobot) Seaglider
    Mission Endurance Estimator user guide (doc. 4366008) was used for parameter names and the
    rule that a dual-pack glider lasts as long as its weaker pack.</p>
  </footer>
</div>
```

<script>
/*
 * Seaglider endurance model (firmware 66.12), fitted to our own dive logs.
 *
 * One function, used both by the page (content/seaglider-endurance.qmd, where the build
 * script inlines it) and by code/build_seaglider_page.js, which runs it against every logged
 * dive before the page is rebuilt. Coefficients come from content/data/seaglider-model.json;
 * see code/fit_seaglider_model.py for how each one was fitted.
 *
 * Everything is Ah drawn from the pack per dive cycle (surface + dive). On a dual-pack
 * glider the pump and motors draw from the 24 V pack and everything else from the 10 V pack,
 * as the Seaglider's own counters book it.
 */
(function (root) {
  "use strict";

  // Science sensors that can be hosted either by the SciCon or polled by the TT8.
  // The SciCon fit covers CT + optode + SeaOWL (+ its aux compass) sampled together, so a
  // subset on the SciCon is charged that fit's per-set energy in proportion to the sensors'
  // TT8-equivalent energy per sample. The proportion is an estimate; the total is measured.
  var SCICON_FITTED_SET = ["SBE_CT", "CONTOPT", "SEAOWL"];

  function sampleEnergy(model, key, mA) {
    var s = model.tt8_sensors[key];
    return (mA == null ? s.mA : mA) * s.s_per_sample; // mAs per sample
  }

  function evaluate(model, cfg) {
    var g = model.gliders[cfg.glider];
    var diveS = 2 * cfg.depth / cfg.w;              // w is the mean vertical speed over the dive
    var diveH = diveS / 3600;
    var cycleH = diveH + cfg.surface_min / 60;
    var callN = Math.max(1, cfg.call_ndives || 1);
    var interval = Math.max(1, cfg.sample_interval);
    var nSamples = diveS / interval;
    var v24 = cfg.battery.v24;

    var parts = [];                                  // [key, label, Ah per dive, bus]
    function add(key, label, ah, bus) { parts.push({ key: key, label: label, ah: ah, bus: bus }); }

    var pumpJ = (cfg.pump_factor || 1) * (cfg.max_buoy + cfg.sm_cc) * (g.pump.a + g.pump.b * cfg.depth);
    add("pump", "Buoyancy pump", pumpJ / (v24 * 3600), 24);
    add("motors", "Pitch and roll motors", g.motors.m0 + g.motors.m1 * diveH, 24);
    add("hotel", "Processor, compass and sleep", g.hotel.h0 + g.hotel.h1 * cycleH, 10);
    // Iridium: the fixed cost of a call is paid every CALL_NDIVES dives, but the data volume
    // still has to go up, so only the fixed part divides.
    add("comms", "Iridium and GPS", g.comms.c0 / callN + g.comms.c1 * cfg.kb, 10);

    // Science sensors, on the SciCon or on the TT8.
    var sci = cfg.science || {};
    var polledS = 0;
    var onSciCon = !!cfg.scicon;
    var fitted = 0, chosen = 0;
    SCICON_FITTED_SET.forEach(function (k) { fitted += sampleEnergy(model, k); });
    Object.keys(sci).forEach(function (k) {
      var s = sci[k];
      if (!s || !s.on) return;
      var label = model.tt8_sensors[k].label;
      if (onSciCon) {
        chosen += sampleEnergy(model, k);
      } else {
        polledS += model.tt8_sensors[k].s_per_sample * nSamples;
        add("sci_" + k, label + " (on TT8)", sampleEnergy(model, k, s.mA) * nSamples / 3.6e6, 10);
      }
    });
    if (onSciCon && chosen > 0) {
      var sc = model.scicon;
      var mA = sc.base_mA + sc.per_set_mAs * (chosen / fitted) / interval;
      add("scicon", "SciCon and its sensors", mA * diveS / 3.6e6, 10);
    }
    var tt8S = g.tt8.per_hour * cycleH + g.tt8.per_eng * nSamples + g.tt8.per_polled * polledS;
    add("tt8", "TT8 sampling", g.tt8.mA * tt8S / 3.6e6, 10);

    // Loggers: current x time recording. They record above a depth, on a share of dives.
    (cfg.loggers || []).forEach(function (L) {
      if (!L.on) return;
      var above = L.record_above == null ? 1 : Math.min(1, L.record_above / cfg.depth);
      var duty = L.duty == null ? 1 : L.duty;
      add("log_" + L.key, L.label, L.mA * diveS * above * duty / 3.6e6, 10);
    });

    var bus24 = 0, bus10 = 0, total = 0;
    parts.forEach(function (p) {
      total += p.ah;
      if (p.bus === 24) bus24 += p.ah; else bus10 += p.ah;
    });

    var b = cfg.battery, keep = 1 - (b.reserve_pct || 0) / 100, dives, limit;
    if (b.dual) {
      var d24 = b.cap24 * keep / bus24, d10 = b.cap10 * keep / bus10;
      dives = Math.min(d24, d10);
      limit = d24 < d10 ? "24 V pack" : "10 V pack";
    } else {
      dives = b.cap24 * keep / total;
      limit = "pack";
    }
    var kmPerDive = 2 * cfg.depth * cfg.glide_ratio / 1000;
    return {
      parts: parts, total: total, bus24: bus24, bus10: bus10,
      dive_h: diveH, cycle_h: cycleH, t_dive_min: diveS / 60,
      dives: dives, days: dives * cycleH / 24, km: dives * kmPerDive,
      ah_per_day: total * 24 / cycleH, km_per_day: kmPerDive * 24 / cycleH,
      limit: limit
    };
  }

  var api = { evaluate: evaluate };
  if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) module.exports = api;
  else root.SeagliderModel = api;
})(this);
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var M = window.SEAGLIDER_MODEL, EV = window.SeagliderModel.evaluate;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var fmt = function (x, d) { return isFinite(x) ? x.toLocaleString("en", { minimumFractionDigits: d || 0, maximumFractionDigits: d || 0 }) : "–"; };
  var esc = function (s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); };

  $("n_dives").textContent = M.dives.toLocaleString("en");

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ sensor rows
  var SCI = [
    { key: "SBE_CT", name: "CT (Sea-Bird)" },
    { key: "CONTOPT", name: "Contros HydroFlash O2 optode" },
    { key: "SEAOWL", name: "WET Labs SeaOWL" },
    { key: "WL_ECO", name: "WET Labs ECO puck (BB2FL)" }
  ];
  var LOG = [
    { key: "PAM", name: "PAM recorder", mA: 55, above: 200 },
    { key: "UVP", name: "UVP6", mA: 80, above: 1000 },
    { key: "ESNDR", name: "Echosounder (ESNDR)", mA: 400, above: 1000 },
    { key: "CUSTOM", name: "Other sensor", mA: 20, above: 1000, custom: true }
  ];
  $("sci_rows").innerHTML = SCI.map(function (s) {
    var t = M.tt8_sensors[s.key];
    return '<div class="sensor"><input type="checkbox" id="c_' + s.key + '" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + '">' +
      '<label class="name" for="c_' + s.key + '">' + esc(s.name) + (t.measured ? "" : '<span class="tag" title="Never flew on the TT8; on-time per sample taken from the ECO puck">est.</span>') + '</label>' +
      '<span class="ctl"><input type="number" id="m_' + s.key + '" min="0" step="1" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' current"><span class="unit">mA</span></span>' +
      '<span class="sub">' + t.s_per_sample.toFixed(2) + ' s powered per sample on the TT8</span></div>';
  }).join("");
  $("log_rows").innerHTML = LOG.map(function (s) {
    return '<div class="sensor"><input type="checkbox" id="c_' + s.key + '" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + '">' +
      (s.custom ? '<input type="text" id="n_' + s.key + '" value="Other sensor" aria-label="Name of the other sensor">' : '<label class="name" for="c_' + s.key + '">' + esc(s.name) + '</label>') +
      '<span class="ctl"><input type="number" id="m_' + s.key + '" min="0" step="1" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' current"><span class="unit">mA</span></span>' +
      '<span class="sub"><span>records above <input type="number" id="a_' + s.key + '" min="1" step="10" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' records above depth"> m</span>' +
      '<span>on <input type="number" id="d_' + s.key + '" min="0" max="100" step="5" aria-label="' + esc(s.name) + ' share of dives"> % of dives</span></span></div>';
  }).join("");

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ presets
  var PRESETS = M.missions.map(function (m) {
    var g = M.gliders[String(m.glider)], s = m.settings, scicon = !!s.scicon;
    var p = {
      label: "SG" + m.glider + " mission " + m.mission + ", " + m.start.slice(0, 7) + " (" + m.dives + " dives)",
      mission: m,
      glider: String(m.glider), depth: m.depth, w: m.w, surface_min: m.surface_min,
      max_buoy: m.max_buoy, sm_cc: m.sm_cc, kb: m.kb, call_ndives: 1,
      pump_factor: m.pump_factor > 1.1 ? m.pump_factor : 1, glide_ratio: m.glide_ratio,
      dual: g.battery.dual, cap24: g.battery.cap24, cap10: g.battery.cap10 || 0,
      v24: g.battery.v24, reserve: 10,
      host: scicon ? "scicon" : "tt8",
      interval: scicon ? s.scicon.interval : m.eng_interval,
      sci: {}, log: {}
    };
    SCI.forEach(function (x) {
      var on = scicon ? ["SBE_CT", "CONTOPT", "SEAOWL"].indexOf(x.key) >= 0 : !!s[x.key];
      p.sci[x.key] = { on: on, mA: M.tt8_sensors[x.key].mA };
    });
    LOG.forEach(function (x) {
      var e = s[x.key];
      p.log[x.key] = { on: !!e, mA: e ? e.mA : x.mA, above: e && e.record_above ? e.record_above : x.above,
                       duty: e ? Math.round(e.duty * 100) : 100 };
    });
    return p;
  });
  var DEFAULT = PRESETS.findIndex(function (p) { return p.mission.glider === 644 && p.mission.mission === 6; });
  if (DEFAULT < 0) DEFAULT = 0;
  $("preset").innerHTML = PRESETS.map(function (p, i) { return '<option value="' + i + '">' + esc(p.label) + "</option>"; }).join("");

  function describe(m) {
    var names = { SciCon: "SciCon (CT, optode, SeaOWL)", PAM: "PAM", UVP: "UVP6", ESNDR: "echosounder",
                  SBE_CT: "CT", CONTOPT: "Contros optode", WL_blue_red_Chl_old_fw: "ECO puck" };
    return m.sensors.map(function (s) { return names[s] || s; }).join(" + ");
  }

  function load(p) {
    $("i_depth").value = p.depth; $("i_w").value = p.w; $("i_surface").value = p.surface_min;
    $("i_maxbuoy").value = p.max_buoy; $("i_smcc").value = p.sm_cc; $("i_kb").value = p.kb;
    $("i_calln").value = p.call_ndives; $("i_glider").value = p.glider; $("i_dual").value = p.dual ? "1" : "0";
    $("i_cap24").value = p.cap24; $("i_cap10").value = p.cap10; $("i_v24").value = p.v24;
    $("i_reserve").value = p.reserve; $("i_pumpf").value = p.pump_factor; $("i_glide").value = p.glide_ratio;
    $("host_" + p.host).checked = true; $("i_interval").value = p.interval;
    SCI.forEach(function (x) { $("c_" + x.key).checked = p.sci[x.key].on; $("m_" + x.key).value = p.sci[x.key].mA; });
    LOG.forEach(function (x) {
      var l = p.log[x.key];
      $("c_" + x.key).checked = l.on; $("m_" + x.key).value = l.mA; $("a_" + x.key).value = l.above; $("d_" + x.key).value = l.duty;
    });
    var m = p.mission, u = m.used;
    $("preset_note").textContent = "As flown " + m.start + " to " + m.end + ": " + describe(m) + ". Dives to " + m.depth +
      " m, " + fmt(u.days, 0) + " days, " + fmt(u.ah_logged, 0) + " Ah logged (" + fmt(u.ah_per_day, 1) + " Ah/day).";
  }

  function signedPct(f) { var v = Math.round(100 * f); return (v > 0 ? "+" : v < 0 ? "\u2212" : "") + Math.abs(v) + "%"; }
  var num = function (id) { var v = parseFloat($(id).value); return isFinite(v) ? v : 0; };

  function readConfig(overrides) {
    var dual = $("i_dual").value === "1";
    var science = {};
    SCI.forEach(function (x) { science[x.key] = { on: $("c_" + x.key).checked, mA: num("m_" + x.key) }; });
    var loggers = LOG.map(function (x) {
      return { key: x.key, label: x.custom ? ($("n_" + x.key).value || "Other sensor") : x.name,
               on: $("c_" + x.key).checked, mA: num("m_" + x.key), record_above: num("a_" + x.key) || null,
               duty: num("d_" + x.key) / 100 };
    });
    var cfg = {
      glider: $("i_glider").value, depth: Math.max(1, num("i_depth")), w: Math.max(0.005, num("i_w")),
      surface_min: num("i_surface"), max_buoy: num("i_maxbuoy"), sm_cc: num("i_smcc"), kb: num("i_kb"),
      call_ndives: Math.max(1, Math.round(num("i_calln"))), sample_interval: Math.max(1, num("i_interval")),
      pump_factor: num("i_pumpf") || 1, glide_ratio: num("i_glide"),
      scicon: $("host_scicon").checked, science: science, loggers: loggers,
      battery: { dual: dual, cap24: num("i_cap24"), cap10: num("i_cap10"), v24: Math.max(1, num("i_v24")), reserve_pct: num("i_reserve") }
    };
    for (var k in overrides || {}) cfg[k] = overrides[k];
    return cfg;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ charts
  // Charts are drawn at their container's pixel width, so text stays 11px at any size.
  var W = 560, H = 280, PAD = { l: 46, r: 16, t: 12, b: 36 };
  function widthOf(id) { return Math.max(240, Math.round($(id).clientWidth || 560)); }
  function niceMax(v) {
    if (!(v > 0)) return 1;
    var e = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v))), f = v / e;
    return (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * e;
  }
  function ticks(max, n) { var out = [], step = max / n; for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) out.push(i * step); return out; }
  function showTip(tip, fig, html, x, y) {
    tip.innerHTML = html; tip.style.display = "block";
    var fw = fig.clientWidth, tw = tip.offsetWidth;
    tip.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(fw - tw - 4, x + 12)) + "px";
    tip.style.top = Math.max(4, y - 10) + "px";
  }

  function drawDepth(cfg, res) {
    var anySci = SCI.some(function (x) { return cfg.science[x.key].on; });
    W = widthOf("ch_depth"); H = Math.round(Math.min(320, Math.max(240, W * 0.5)));
    var depths = []; for (var d = 50; d <= 1000; d += 25) depths.push(d);
    var series = [
      { name: "Sensors on the SciCon", cls: "var(--s1)", scicon: true },
      { name: "Sensors on the TT8", cls: "var(--s2)", scicon: false }
    ];
    if (!anySci) series = [{ name: "Endurance", cls: "var(--s1)", scicon: cfg.scicon }];
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      s.pts = depths.map(function (d) {
        var r = EV(M, readConfig({ depth: d, scicon: s.scicon }));
        return { d: d, days: r.days, km: r.km };
      });
    });
    var ymax = niceMax(Math.max.apply(null, series.map(function (s) { return Math.max.apply(null, s.pts.map(function (p) { return p.days; })); })));
    var x = function (d) { return PAD.l + (d - 50) / 950 * (W - PAD.l - PAD.r); };
    var y = function (v) { return H - PAD.b - v / ymax * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b); };
    var svg = '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + W + " " + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Endurance in days against dive depth">';
    ticks(ymax, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<line class="grid" x1="' + PAD.l + '" x2="' + (W - PAD.r) + '" y1="' + y(t) + '" y2="' + y(t) + '"/>' +
        '<text x="' + (PAD.l - 6) + '" y="' + (y(t) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + fmt(t, ymax < 10 ? 1 : 0) + "</text>";
    });
    [100, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000].forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<text x="' + x(t) + '" y="' + (H - PAD.b + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + t + "</text>";
    });
    svg += '<text x="' + ((W + PAD.l) / 2) + '" y="' + (H - 4) + '" text-anchor="middle">Dive depth (m)</text>';
    svg += '<text x="12" y="' + (PAD.t + 4) + '" transform="rotate(-90 12 ' + (PAD.t + 4) + ')" text-anchor="end">days</text>';
    svg += '<line class="axis" x1="' + PAD.l + '" x2="' + (W - PAD.r) + '" y1="' + y(0) + '" y2="' + y(0) + '"/>';
    if (cfg.depth >= 50 && cfg.depth <= 1000)
      svg += '<line x1="' + x(cfg.depth) + '" x2="' + x(cfg.depth) + '" y1="' + PAD.t + '" y2="' + y(0) + '" style="stroke:var(--ink-3);stroke-dasharray:3 3"/>';
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      svg += '<path d="' + s.pts.map(function (p, i) { return (i ? "L" : "M") + x(p.d).toFixed(1) + "," + y(p.days).toFixed(1); }).join("") +
        '" fill="none" style="stroke:' + s.cls + '" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
    });
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      var last = s.pts[s.pts.length - 1];
      var cur = s.scicon === cfg.scicon;
      svg += '<circle cx="' + x(Math.min(1000, Math.max(50, cfg.depth))) + '" cy="' + y(EV(M, readConfig({ scicon: s.scicon })).days) + '" r="' + (cur ? 5 : 4) + '" style="fill:' + s.cls + ';stroke:var(--surface);stroke-width:2"/>';
    });
    svg += '<g id="xh" style="display:none"><line class="axis" y1="' + PAD.t + '" y2="' + y(0) + '"/></g>';
    svg += '<rect x="' + PAD.l + '" y="' + PAD.t + '" width="' + (W - PAD.l - PAD.r) + '" height="' + (H - PAD.t - PAD.b) + '" fill="transparent" id="hit_depth"/>';
    svg += "</svg>";
    $("ch_depth").innerHTML = svg;
    $("leg_depth").innerHTML = series.map(function (s) {
      return '<span><i style="background:' + s.cls + '"></i>' + esc(s.name) + (s.scicon === cfg.scicon && series.length > 1 ? " (selected)" : "") + "</span>";
    }).join("") + '<span style="color:var(--ink-3)">dashed line: your depth</span>';

    var fig = $("fig_depth"), tip = $("tip_depth"), svgEl = fig.querySelector("svg"), xh = svgEl.querySelector("#xh");
    var hit = svgEl.querySelector("#hit_depth");
    function move(ev) {
      var r = svgEl.getBoundingClientRect(), sx = (ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width * W;
      var i = Math.max(0, Math.min(depths.length - 1, Math.round((sx - PAD.l) / (W - PAD.l - PAD.r) * (depths.length - 1))));
      var line = xh.querySelector("line"); line.setAttribute("x1", x(depths[i])); line.setAttribute("x2", x(depths[i])); xh.style.display = "";
      var fr = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
      showTip(tip, fig, "<div>" + depths[i] + " m dives</div>" + series.map(function (s) {
        return '<div><i style="display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;background:' + s.cls + '"></i>' + esc(s.name) + ": <b>" + fmt(s.pts[i].days, 0) + "</b> days, " + fmt(s.pts[i].km, 0) + " km</div>";
      }).join(""), ev.clientX - fr.left, ev.clientY - fr.top);
    }
    hit.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
    hit.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { tip.style.display = "none"; xh.style.display = "none"; });
  }

  function drawParts(res) {
    var perDay = 24 / res.cycle_h;
    var rows = res.parts.filter(function (p) { return p.ah > 0; }).map(function (p) { return { label: p.label, v: p.ah * perDay, dive: p.ah, bus: p.bus }; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b.v - a.v; });
    var W2 = widthOf("ch_parts"), rowH = 26, LBL = Math.min(190, W2 * 0.45), H2 = rows.length * rowH + 30;
    var xmax = niceMax(rows.length ? rows[0].v : 1);
    var x = function (v) { return LBL + v / xmax * (W2 - LBL - 60); };
    var svg = '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + W2 + " " + H2 + '" role="img" aria-label="Energy by load in Ah per day">';
    ticks(xmax, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<line class="grid" x1="' + x(t) + '" x2="' + x(t) + '" y1="0" y2="' + (rows.length * rowH) + '"/>' +
        '<text x="' + x(t) + '" y="' + (rows.length * rowH + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + fmt(t, xmax < 2 ? 2 : 1) + "</text>";
    });
    rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
      var y0 = i * rowH + 5, w = Math.max(2, x(r.v) - LBL);
      svg += '<text class="lab" x="' + (LBL - 8) + '" y="' + (y0 + 12) + '" text-anchor="end">' + esc(r.label.length > 30 ? r.label.slice(0, 29) + "…" : r.label) + "</text>" +
        '<rect x="' + LBL + '" y="' + y0 + '" width="' + w + '" height="16" rx="4" style="fill:var(--s1)"/>' +
        '<text class="val" x="' + (LBL + w + 6) + '" y="' + (y0 + 12) + '">' + fmt(r.v, 2) + "</text>" +
        '<rect x="0" y="' + (i * rowH) + '" width="' + W2 + '" height="' + rowH + '" fill="transparent" data-i="' + i + '"/>';
    });
    svg += "</svg>";
    $("ch_parts").innerHTML = svg;
    var fig = $("fig_parts"), tip = $("tip_parts"), total = res.total;
    fig.querySelectorAll("rect[data-i]").forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener("mousemove", function (ev) {
        var r = rows[+el.getAttribute("data-i")], fr = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
        showTip(tip, fig, "<div>" + esc(r.label) + "</div><div><b>" + fmt(r.v, 3) + "</b> Ah/day, <b>" + fmt(r.dive, 4) + "</b> Ah/dive</div><div>" +
          fmt(100 * r.dive / total, 0) + "% of the load" + ($("i_dual").value === "1" ? ", " + r.bus + " V pack" : "") + "</div>", ev.clientX - fr.left, ev.clientY - fr.top);
      });
      el.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { tip.style.display = "none"; });
    });
  }

  function drawValidation() {
    var rows = M.validation.map(function (v) {
      var m = M.missions.find(function (x) { return x.glider === v.glider && x.mission === v.mission; });
      return { v: v, m: m, logged: m.used.ah_per_day, model: m.used.ah_per_day * v.ratio };
    });
    var W2 = Math.min(760, widthOf("ch_valid")), rowH = 30, LBL = 130, H2 = rows.length * rowH + 32;
    var xmax = niceMax(Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(function (r) { return Math.max(r.logged, r.model); })));
    var x = function (v) { return LBL + v / xmax * (W2 - LBL - 70); };
    var svg = '<svg style="max-width:' + W2 + 'px" viewBox="0 0 ' + W2 + " " + H2 + '" role="img" aria-label="Energy per day by mission, logged against model">';
    ticks(xmax, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      svg += '<line class="grid" x1="' + x(t) + '" x2="' + x(t) + '" y1="0" y2="' + (rows.length * rowH) + '"/>' +
        '<text x="' + x(t) + '" y="' + (rows.length * rowH + 16) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + fmt(t, 0) + "</text>";
    });
    svg += '<text x="' + ((W2 + LBL) / 2) + '" y="' + (H2 - 2) + '" text-anchor="middle">Ah per day</text>';
    rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
      var yc = i * rowH + rowH / 2;
      var a = x(Math.min(r.logged, r.model)), b = x(Math.max(r.logged, r.model));
      svg += '<text class="lab" x="' + (LBL - 10) + '" y="' + (yc + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">SG' + r.v.glider + " m" + r.v.mission + " · " + r.m.start.slice(0, 4) + "</text>" +
        '<line x1="' + a + '" x2="' + b + '" y1="' + yc + '" y2="' + yc + '" style="stroke:var(--line-strong)" stroke-width="2"/>' +
        '<circle cx="' + x(r.logged) + '" cy="' + yc + '" r="5" style="fill:var(--s1);stroke:var(--surface);stroke-width:2"/>' +
        '<circle cx="' + x(r.model) + '" cy="' + yc + '" r="5" style="fill:var(--s2);stroke:var(--surface);stroke-width:2"/>' +
        '<text class="val" x="' + (b + 10) + '" y="' + (yc + 4) + '">' + signedPct(r.v.ratio - 1) + "</text>" +
        '<rect x="0" y="' + (i * rowH) + '" width="' + W2 + '" height="' + rowH + '" fill="transparent" data-i="' + i + '"/>';
    });
    svg += "</svg>";
    $("ch_valid").innerHTML = svg;
    var fig = $("ch_valid").parentNode, tip = $("tip_valid");
    fig.querySelectorAll("rect[data-i]").forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener("mousemove", function (ev) {
        var r = rows[+el.getAttribute("data-i")], fr = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
        showTip(tip, fig, "<div>SG" + r.v.glider + " mission " + r.v.mission + ", " + r.v.dives + " dives</div><div>Logged <b>" + fmt(r.logged, 2) + "</b> Ah/day, model <b>" + fmt(r.model, 2) + "</b></div><div>Median error on a single dive " + fmt(100 * r.v.median_dive_error, 0) + "%</div>", ev.clientX - fr.left, ev.clientY - fr.top);
      });
      el.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () { tip.style.display = "none"; });
    });

    $("t_valid").innerHTML = "<thead><tr><th class='t'>Mission</th><th>Dives</th><th>Logged Ah</th><th>Model Ah</th><th>Model / logged</th><th>With pump factor</th><th>Median dive error</th></tr></thead><tbody>" +
      rows.map(function (r) {
        return "<tr><td class='t'>SG" + r.v.glider + " mission " + r.v.mission + " (" + r.m.start.slice(0, 7) + ")</td><td>" + r.v.dives + "</td><td>" + fmt(r.v.logged_ah, 1) + "</td><td>" + fmt(r.v.model_ah, 1) +
          "</td><td>" + r.v.ratio.toFixed(2) + "</td><td>" + r.v.ratio_with_factor.toFixed(2) + " (&times;" + r.m.pump_factor.toFixed(2) + ")</td><td>" + fmt(100 * r.v.median_dive_error, 0) + "%</td></tr>";
      }).join("") + "</tbody>";
  }

  function drawMissions() {
    $("t_missions").innerHTML = "<thead><tr><th class='t'>Mission</th><th class='t'>Dates</th><th class='t'>Sensors</th><th>Dives</th><th>Median depth</th><th>Days</th><th>Ah logged</th><th>Glider counter</th><th>Ah/day</th></tr></thead><tbody>" +
      M.missions.map(function (m) {
        return "<tr><td class='t'>SG" + m.glider + " m" + m.mission + "</td><td class='t'>" + m.start + " to " + m.end + "</td><td class='t'>" + esc(describe(m)) + "</td><td>" + m.dives + "</td><td>" + m.depth + " m</td><td>" + fmt(m.used.days, 1) + "</td><td>" + fmt(m.used.ah_logged, 1) + "</td><td>" + fmt(m.used.counter_ah, 1) + "</td><td>" + fmt(m.used.ah_per_day, 2) + "</td></tr>";
      }).join("") + "</tbody>";
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ update
  function update() {
    var dual = $("i_dual").value === "1";
    $("i_cap10").disabled = !dual;
    $("l_cap24").textContent = dual ? "24 V pack capacity" : "Capacity";
    $("l_v24").textContent = dual ? "24 V pack voltage" : "Pack voltage";
    var onSci = $("host_scicon").checked;
    SCI.forEach(function (x) { $("m_" + x.key).disabled = onSci || !$("c_" + x.key).checked; });
    LOG.forEach(function (x) { ["m_", "a_", "d_"].forEach(function (p) { $(p + x.key).disabled = !$("c_" + x.key).checked; }); });
    $("sci_note").textContent = onSci
      ? "On the SciCon, cost follows the SciCon's own measured draw (" + M.scicon.base_mA + " mA plus " + M.scicon.per_set_mAs + " mAs per sample of the CT, optode and SeaOWL together), so the mA boxes are not used."
      : "On the TT8, each sensor is charged its current for the seconds it is powered per sample, and the TT8 stays awake while it is polled.";

    var cfg = readConfig(), res = EV(M, cfg);
    $("o_days").textContent = fmt(res.days, 0);
    $("o_km").textContent = fmt(res.km, 0);
    $("o_dives").textContent = fmt(res.dives, 0);
    $("o_ahday").textContent = fmt(res.ah_per_day, 2);
    $("o_ahdive").textContent = fmt(res.total, 3);
    $("o_cycle").textContent = fmt(res.cycle_h, 2) + " h";
    $("o_limit").textContent = res.limit;
    $("h_w").textContent = "Including apogee. T_DIVE equivalent " + fmt(res.t_dive_min, 0) + " min.";

    var anySci = SCI.some(function (x) { return cfg.science[x.key].on; });
    if (anySci) {
      var a = EV(M, readConfig({ scicon: true })), b = EV(M, readConfig({ scicon: false }));
      $("compare").innerHTML =
        '<span class="' + (cfg.scicon ? "cur" : "") + '">Science sensors on the SciCon: <b>' + fmt(a.days, 0) + "</b> days, " + fmt(a.ah_per_day, 2) + " Ah/day</span>" +
        '<span class="' + (!cfg.scicon ? "cur" : "") + '">On the TT8 (no SciCon): <b>' + fmt(b.days, 0) + "</b> days, " + fmt(b.ah_per_day, 2) + " Ah/day</span>" +
        "<span>Difference <b>" + (b.days - a.days >= 0 ? "+" : "") + fmt(b.days - a.days, 0) + "</b> days without the SciCon</span>";
    } else {
      $("compare").innerHTML = "<span>No science sensors ticked, so there is nothing to compare between the SciCon and the TT8.</span>";
    }

    var alerts = [];
    if (cfg.depth > 1000) alerts.push("Deeper than 1000 m: beyond the Seaglider's rating and anything these gliders logged.");
    if (cfg.glider === "150" && cfg.depth > 300) alerts.push("SG150 never dove past 300 m; its pump cost at this depth is extrapolated with SG644's depth slope.");
    if (cfg.w < 0.05 || cfg.w > 0.2) alerts.push("Mean vertical speed outside 0.05–0.2 m/s, the range these missions flew.");
    if (cfg.battery.dual !== M.gliders[cfg.glider].battery.dual) alerts.push("Pack layout differs from the calibration glider's; loads are split 24 V (pump, motors) and 10 V (everything else) as Seaglider books them.");
    if (!cfg.scicon && cfg.science.SEAOWL.on) alerts.push("The SeaOWL never flew on the TT8; its cost there is estimated from the ECO puck.");
    var pam = cfg.loggers[0];
    if (pam.on && pam.mA > 0) alerts.push("The PAM is counted here, but the glider's own battery counter leaves it out: expect the glider to report more remaining than there is.");
    $("alerts").innerHTML = alerts.map(function (t) { return '<div class="alert">' + esc(t) + "</div>"; }).join("");

    drawDepth(cfg, res);
    drawParts(res);
  }

  $("preset").addEventListener("change", function () { load(PRESETS[+this.value]); update(); });
  $("reset").addEventListener("click", function () { load(PRESETS[+$("preset").value]); update(); });
  document.querySelectorAll("#sge .panels input, #sge .panels select").forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener("input", update); el.addEventListener("change", update);
  });
  var rt; window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(function () { update(); drawValidation(); }, 150); });

  $("preset").value = String(DEFAULT);
  load(PRESETS[DEFAULT]);
  update();
  drawValidation();
  drawMissions();
  // Quarto settles its layout (sidebar, margins) after this script runs, and the charts are
  // drawn at their container's width, so draw once more when the page has finished loading.
  window.addEventListener("load", function () { update(); drawValidation(); });
})();
</script>
```
